notes: First run with sonde's limit probes. Opt-in probes (slow, spends-quota, crash-risk) were not selected.
SDK versions are sonde's exact pins at this build (its package.json); the markdown report does not carry them.
Picked file names and the product account are redacted.

retracted.host.limits.bridgePayload: sonde grew the input to deriveEntropy, which accepts at most 32 bytes, so this measured that call's argument check, not the bridge. Fixed in sonde (a4683ff): it now round-trips growing values through host local storage.
retracted.host.preimage.submit: Not measured: it depended on host.cloud.allowance, a gesture probe that always runs after the unattended ones. Fixed in sonde (a4683ff): it requests the allowance itself.
retracted.host.limits.statementSize: Not a size limit: the account was full of statements with no expiry, which sonde's own host.statement.submit had been adding every run, so any statement with a finite expiry was refused AccountFull(minExpiry=i64::MAX). The refusal itself is a real platform behaviour (see the Statement Store page). Fixed in sonde (a4683ff).
retracted.host.limits.statementLatency: Not measured: refused for the same reason as host.limits.statementSize — the account was full of sonde's own no-expiry statements. Fixed in sonde (a4683ff).
